label: after
method: Real stage start, real opening-dialogue keyboard input, ten seconds of live normal-damage RAF.
screenshotMethod: Untouched current game-canvas pixels; PNG and measurement metadata read in the same evaluation.

contrastMetric.colorSpace: sRGB channels linearized with the standard 0.04045 transfer breakpoint
contrastMetric.hero: median luminance in a facing-aligned ellipse, world radii 12 and 16
contrastMetric.floor: median luminance in a 28..48-world-unit annulus, excluding other character bodies
contrastMetric.dressing: Baked floor dressing is retained; no post-observation bright-pixel exclusion.

limitations: Initial live stage views, not full playthroughs or every combat/lighting state.
The numerical contrast check cannot establish one-second recognition by a first-time viewer.
The ordinary quality governor remains enabled; effective DPR and tier are recorded.

captureEncoding.verification: Decoded RGBA pixel bytes are identical to the original PNG.
